inv.location: Calle del General Pardiñas, 69, Lista, Barrio de Salamanca, Madrid
features: 1 toilet or bathroom adapted for disabled people
inv.desc_es:
Se alquila sala de podología, con todas las licencias en vigor. Se encuentra en “Clínica Begaro”, centro multidisciplinar situado en Madrid capital, en pleno Barrio de Salamanca. Excelentemente comunicada tanto por Metro como por líneas de autobuses.
Sala completamente equipada con instrumental y materiales nuevos (Namrol). Dispone de bomba de frío/calor individual, lavamanos e hilo musical.
Disponibilidad inmediata, en horario de 10:00h a 20:00h ininterrumpido de lunes a viernes.
Precio: 700€/mes (Posibilidad también de alquilar por días).
inv.desc_en:
Podiatry room for rent, with all licenses in force. It is located in "Clínica Begaro", a multidisciplinary physiotherapy center located in Madrid, in the heart of the Salamanca district. Excellently communicated both by Metro and by bus lines.
Room fully equipped with practically new instruments and materials (Nanrol brand). Also possibility of using own instruments instead of the one from the clinic. It has an individual hot/cold pump, sink and piped music.
Immediate availability, from 9:00 a. m. to 8:00 p. m. uninterrupted from Monday to Friday.
Price: €300/month (Possibility also to rent for days or by percentage per treatment).
